title: Captain Jim Sportfishing Honolulu LLC
specs: Catch Yellow Fin Tuna, Pacific Blue Marlin, and Mahi-Mahi any time of the year
Book this private fishing charter and except for Food and Drinks, Captain Jim will supply all the fishing gear, homemade specialty lures, and 200lbs of ice to keep everything cold.
Alcohol is allowed on the boat. (no glass containers).
Private charters for you and 5 friends or family members

services.name: Trolling Fishing Charters
services.desc: Captain Jim is a US Coast Guard licensed captain with 45 years of fishing and boating experience in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, California, and Mexico, with 20+ years in the Hawaiian Islands.! Times and duration Monday thru Saturday 6am thru 2pm 4, 6, 8 and 10 hour charters available About Captain Jim trolls for Hawaii’s Pelagic Fish and he’ll give you a sporting chance to catch them any time of the year. Ten minutes after getting underway the trolling lines are in the water. On the way out to the prime fishing areas, there’s a good chance of catching Mahi-Mahi, Ono and Aku. Once in the 6 People Maximum

services.name: Bottom Fishing Charters
services.desc: Captain Jim is a US Coast Guard licensed captain with 45 years of fishing and boating experience in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, California, and Mexico, with 20+ years in the Hawaiian Islands.! Times and duration Monday thru Saturday 6am thru 2pm 2, 3, and 4 hour Charters available About A fun fishing adventure for any angler. The charter gets underway and within 15 minutes the lines are in the water. On the reef you’ll have a chance to catch an assortment of amazing fish, like red & gray snapper, jacks & trevallies, and parrot fish to name a few, let’s see what you can bring aboard! Book 6 People Maximum

services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Captain Jim is a US Coast Guard licensed captain with 45 years of fishing and boating experience in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, California, and Mexico, with 20+ years in the Hawaiian Islands.! Times and duration Monday thru Saturday 6am thru 2pm 2 hour, 3 hour and 4 hour boat ride available About If fishing isn’t for you and you’d like to take a 2 to 4 hour boat ride at sunrise/sunset, or anytime, we can do that too. Whale watching in season (Nov-Mar) is amazing and the Sightseeing and Turtle Tour is fun 6 People Maximum

services.name: Sunset Tours/ Friday Night Fireworks
services.desc: Captain Jim is a US Coast Guard licensed captain with 45 years of fishing and boating experience in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, California, and Mexico, with 20+ years in the Hawaiian Islands.! Times and duration Monday thru Saturday 4 or 5pm start (3hr) or 5 or 6pm start (2hr) (based on time of year) 2-hour and 3-hour boat ride available About 2 or 3 Hour Sunset Cruise. Bring your own food and drinks and enjoy the Waikiki coastline and Diamondhead while you witness an extraordinary sunset. On Friday Nights, you'll be treated to a dazzling display of Fireworks over the water from the boat! 6 People Maximum
